_doc: Brief CH-0 — Gauntlet v2 case list (SOURCE OF TRUTH; Ops/reports/ch-model-bakeoff/gauntlet-v2-cases.md is generated from this by `gauntlet.py emit-md`). One CHAT = one app launch = one fresh conversation; its cases run in order inside it. Each case runs × Thinking {off,on} (where the model supports it) × 3 runs. Every row is graded by EVERY applicable grader (see gauntlet.py GRADERS); fields below only add case-specific expectations.
refusals: read in full" section is empty

cases.what: follow-up carries the same entry (working set, no re-retrieval)
cases.question: Interpret my medical results.

cases.what: bare deictic follow-up keeps the SAME entry open
